title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Job Description – Mobile App Developer

**Experience:** 5–7 Years  
**Department:** Software Development / Engineering  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Job Location:** Karve Nagar,Pune  
**Company Name:** Probit Softech Pvt Ltd

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and skilled **Mobile App Developer** with 5–7 years of experience in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining high-quality mobile applications. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in mobile application development, a good understanding of UI/UX principles, API integration, application performance optimization, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, test, and maintain robust, scalable, and user-friendly mobile applications.
* Develop mobile applications for Android platforms using relevant technologies.
* Write clean, reusable, efficient, and maintainable code following industry best practices.
* Integrate RESTful APIs, third-party libraries, payment gateways, push notifications, and other external services.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA engineers, and product managers.
* Identify and resolve bugs, performance issues, and application crashes.
* Optimize application performance, responsiveness, security, and overall user experience.
* Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards.
* Manage application releases, deployment, and publishing on the Google Play Store and/or Apple App Store.
* Implement application security practices and ensure data protection.
* Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely technical solutions.
* Stay updated with the latest mobile development technologies, tools, and industry trends.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical discussions and knowledge sharing.

Required Technical Skills

* 5–7 years of hands-on experience in mobile application development.
* Strong proficiency in at least one mobile development technology:
* **Flutter / Dart**
* **React Native / JavaScript / TypeScript**
* Good understanding of mobile application architecture, design patterns, and state management.
* Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON, and third-party SDKs.
* Knowledge of Git and version control systems.
* Experience with debugging, unit testing, and performance optimization.
* Understanding of mobile application security, authentication, and authorization.
* Familiarity with Firebase, push notifications, analytics, and crash reporting tools.
* Knowledge of app deployment and release management.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated build processes.
* Familiarity with offline data storage, caching, and synchronization.
* Experience with payment gateway integration and real-time communication features.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks.
* Experience working with cloud services and backend integrations.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards and responsive UI design.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and commitment to delivering quality software.

Key Competencies

* Technical problem-solving
* Application architecture and development
* Team collaboration and communication
* Code quality and optimization
* Time management and ownership
* Technical mentoring and continuous learning

What We Are Looking For

A proactive and technically strong Mobile App Developer who can take ownership of mobile application development, deliver reliable and high-performance applications, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and contribute to the overall success of the development team.

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
